list.title: Ownership disputes
list.sub: When two people say they are a child’s parent, trust & safety checks and decides who the profile belongs to. Here you can follow each case.
list.emptyBody: You are not part of any ownership dispute. If you try to add a child who is already registered, you can open one from the add-child form.
list.errBody: Nothing has changed in your cases. Check your internet connection and try again.

outcome.keptClaimant: The profile stays with its current owner
outcome.transferredClaimant: The profile was transferred to you — confirm the consents and the educators’ access
outcome.transferredOwner: The profile was transferred to the other parent

detail.privacy: Only you see your statements. The other person never sees your name, phone number or words — and you don’t see theirs.
detail.stepStatementsNow: Trust & safety reads both sides and may call you
detail.next1: Trust & safety may call both of you to hear each side.
detail.next2: Documents are checked by phone or video call. Never upload or send copies of documents — we will never ask you to.
detail.next3: A profile has exactly one owner. Both of you get an SMS with the decision.
detail.outcomeKeptClaimant: Trust & safety checked both sides and left the profile with its current owner. If the owner agrees, they can invite you as a co-guardian.
detail.outcomeKeptOwner: Trust & safety checked both sides. Nothing changes for you or your child.
detail.outcomeTransferredClaimant: You are now the child’s owner. Every earlier consent has ended, and the educators’ access is paused until you answer. Please review them now.
detail.outcomeTransferredOwner: Trust & safety checked both sides and transferred the profile. You no longer see this child’s reports.
detail.notFoundBody: This case doesn’t exist or you are not part of it.
detail.errBody: Nothing has changed in the case. Check your internet connection and try again.

form.title: Your statements
form.none: You haven’t written a statement yet.
form.label: Add a statement
form.hint: Describe what happened and what can be checked: who looks after the child, which school they attend, who has used the profile. Don’t write ID document numbers.
form.sent: Statement added. Trust & safety will read it.
form.limit: You have written {max} statements — the most a case accepts. If something new comes up, trust & safety will hear it when they call.
form.closed: The case is decided, so no more statements are accepted.

errors.CASE_CLOSED: The case has just been decided, so the statement wasn’t added.
errors.TOO_MANY_STATEMENTS: You have reached the limit of 10 statements for this case.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This case is no longer available to you.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The statement must be between 1 and 4000 characters.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Your text is still here — try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

access.titleCheck: We paused {educator}’s access to {child} during a safety check. Did you give this access?
access.reasonCheck: Trust & safety is checking a pattern in this educator’s groups.
access.reasonDecision: Trust & safety found a problem with this educator’s account.
access.reasonOwnership: You became the owner of this profile after an ownership dispute. The previous owner gave this access, so it waits for your answer.
access.meanwhile: Meanwhile {educator} can’t see {child}’s wave results, error types or reports. Nothing is deleted.
access.coNote: Only the owner, {owner}, can answer. Until then the access stays paused.
access.coNoteNoOwner: Only the profile owner can answer. Until then the access stays paused.
access.dlgBody: {educator} will no longer see {child}’s reports. {child}’s history stays with your family, and trust & safety is told about your answer.
access.keptResult: Done: {educator} can see {child}’s reports again until {date}. If trust & safety has paused the educator’s whole account, they still see nothing until that check ends.
access.answered: This was already answered. The page now shows the current state.
access.forbidden: Only the profile owner can answer this.
access.awaitingDesc: Paused during a safety check · your answer is needed above

entry.title: Open disputes: {n}
entry.body: Follow the case, add a statement and see the decision.
entry.followBody: Add statements and see the decision on the case page.
